page: OVHcloud r3-64 is a memory-optimized server instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC processor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs operating at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is provided via a 200 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a 2 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core capabilities, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance scoring in the top 25% at 3078.58. Memory write bandwidth for large blocks is also strong at 101.05 GB/sec, matching a strong PassMark memory score of 2964.73. Multi-core CPU performance, read-only memory bandwidth, and database operations fall within the average tier. Text processing and text generation for small language models also demonstrate strong performance, while larger workloads like medium-model LLM inference and software compilation perform at average speeds.

The r3-64 instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads due to its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated CPU allocation without hyperthreading. However, a tradeoff is present in its multi-core scaling, as multi-core CPU performance and multi-threaded decompression benchmarks remain in the average tier. This server is suited for memory-bound applications, database operations, caching layers, and text processing tasks that benefit from dedicated physical cores and fast local NVMe storage.
